baseline.equivalence_test: No-hook and disabled-hook paths must match token IDs, logits, generated-token count, and compact path hashes on a future no-task-data fixture.

core_invariants: Production selector, retrieval, selected IDs/order, context, prompt, decode policy, evaluator, labels, answers, and candidate path remain frozen.
Reader spans are gold-free pre-generation locators only; gold, answer, evaluator, split, post-generation output, and result feedback are forbidden.
The hook is installed by a context manager for one Generator call and removed in finally; no process-global hook or implicit discovery.
Exactly one mutually exclusive arm is active per call: disabled, reader, or geometry-matched non-reader control.
Formal utility remains blocked pending separately authorized screen, preregistration, full-data run, and independent-executor replication.

invariants: Unchanged prompt serialization and token IDs are asserted; raw text is memory-only and never persisted.
Anchors use the Generator's own layer-30 prompt states; the same shared prompt mean is removed from reader and control anchors.
Only the input pre-hook of model.model.layers[30] may be modified; layers 30 and 31 remain downstream.

plugins.insertion_point: Existing prompt serializer/tokenizer boundary; assert exact prompt and token preservation.
plugins.hypothesis: Frozen gold-free reader offsets can be mapped to existing Generator token indices without changing the prompt.
plugins.resource_estimate: Plan only; future fixture uses tokenizer offset mapping without retrieval or evaluation.

plugins.insertion_point: First layer-30 pre-forward call, before residual modification.
plugins.hypothesis: Layer-30 prompt states provide a native anchor space without external projection or span-text copying.
plugins.resource_estimate: Plan only; persist compact tensor geometry and checksums only.

plugins.insertion_point: Same scoped layer-30 pre-hook, returning hidden_states unchanged.
plugins.hypothesis: Adapter plumbing has exact disabled-path parity with the frozen Generator.
plugins.resource_estimate: Plan only; one deterministic no-task-data parity fixture per arm.

plugins.insertion_point: Layer-30 pre-hook; add one fixed anchor to the final non-padding prompt token and each cached decode token.
plugins.hypothesis: Reader-localized native states can alter evidence use through two downstream Transformer blocks, not a terminal logit bias.
plugins.resource_estimate: Unimplemented; future no-task-data fixture, then separately authorized report-only screen.

plugins.insertion_point: Identical layer-30 hook and answer-prefix positions with disjoint non-reader spans matching reader count and lengths.
plugins.hypothesis: A deterministic matched null isolates reader content from generic prompt geometry and shared residual structure.
plugins.resource_estimate: Unimplemented; no extra model loading beyond the corresponding active arm.

composition.merge_rule: Provenance and capture precede exactly one mutually exclusive transport arm; active arms replace, never compose with, the disabled arm.
interaction_ablations: Reader versus matched non-reader at identical geometry, alpha, layer, decoding, and context.
Each active arm versus final-linear-readout-plus-rescaling surrogate.

validation.baseline_equivalence: No-hook and disabled-hook outputs must be exactly equal on a deterministic no-task-data fixture.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: plan-only: no task dataset, labels, answers, passages, predictions, or evaluator output
reproducibility.environment: plan-only; source inspection of 3080Ti Llama-3 8B, Transformers 4.44.0, Torch 2.7.1+cu126
reproducibility.output_manifest: Future runs must emit compact model/config hashes, layer, shape, geometry, timing, and metrics only.

full_real_data_l2.formal_data_scope: Complete preregistered natural NQ-open population fixed before any formal run; no post-hoc eligibility or slice selection.
full_real_data_l2.data_exposure_policy: Git retains compact summaries at or below 1 MiB; larger raw result files use authenticated exchange and are represented by path, size, and SHA-256.
full_real_data_l2.l4_attribution_plan: After L2/L3 only, compare reader and matched-null transport with final-logit, finite-shot, and resource controls.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Reader-minus-matched-null downstream answer-prefix attention redistribution and final-linear-readout-plus-rescaling R2 below 0.90.

limitations: Plan-only: no hook implementation, model loading, task data, generation, or utility result.
The project has no residual-plugin boundary or exact prompt-provenance adapter yet.
Any no-task-data model fixture or real-data stage requires separate authorization.
